propositions: Status mapping must be config-driven per-project via S1 mapping_config instead of hardcoded, with outbound consumers resolving the effective map through the OutboundMapper protocol
Unmapped local statuses must drift (omit status field, leaving Jira unchanged) with deduped non-fatal alerts, never coerce or fail
Config remaps and collapsed status pairs must round-trip losslessly via rebar-status:<local> labels without requiring a reverse map, recoverable inbound via shared derived vocabulary
The outbound_differ seam must resolve per-project maps from repo_root (not CWD) and thread the status_map through CREATE/UPDATE paths and label generation
Fetcher and preflight_status_mapping must tolerate config-only/remapped Jira status names via declared_status_names helper
Duplicated rebar-status label parsing literals must be consolidated into a single shared helper with derived vocabulary covering all possible local status values
